description: This file defines function prototypes related to preloading an index in a version control system. It declares functions for preloading an index and reading a repository index preload, as well as forward declarations for structures used in these functions.

methods.name: preload_index
methods.description: Preloads the index with specified path specifications and refresh flags.

methods.name: repo_read_index_preload
methods.description: Reads the index preload from the repository with specified path specifications and refresh flags.
